parts.problem_md:
A college principal has decided that students can use mobile devices to take notes in lessons. Some students use laptop computers whilst others use smartphones.

There are safety issues related to bringing laptop computers into the college. The Network Manager has decided to produce a paper-based certificate for students to prove that their laptop computer is safe to use.

**Describe **the main features that should be considered for the design of this certificate
parts.solution_md:
Examples of the features that should be considered for the design include:

Any **four **of the following:

- Text size should be easy/large enough to read **[1 mark]**
- Font style should be easy to read **[1 mark]**
- Make good use of white space so data fills the certificate **[1 mark]**
- Enough space in which to enter the answers in the text boxes **[1 mark]**
- Make good use of colours to make it easy to read **[1 mark]**
- Use an organised layout to make it easy to read **[1 mark]**
- All information needs to be clearly visible **[1 mark]**
- Use of tick boxes to make data entry quicker/easier **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
A search engine can be used to find information on the internet.

The student plans to create a table, using word processing software, to display the information he has found out about the animal.

The completed table will look like this:

| **Name of animal** | Tiger quoll |
|---|---|
| **Scientific name** | Dasyurus maculatus |
| **Pouched** | No |
| **Habitat** | Australia |
| **Conservation status** | Threatened |

The student has saved a picture from the internet of a tiger quoll.

**Explain **how he could create a new row above the Pouched row and place the picture into the right-hand cell of this new row.
parts.solution_md:
The student could create a new row and insert the picture by:

Any **four **of the following:

Max **three **from:

- Highlight Scientific name row **[1 mark]**
- Right click select insert **[1 mark]**
- Click Insert new row below **[1 mark]**

**OR**

- Highlight Pouched row **[1 mark]**
- Right click select insert **[1 mark]**
- Click Insert new row above **[1 mark]**

**AND **max **three **from:

- Click on right hand cell in the row **[1 mark]**
- Click insert…pictures Locate/select picture **[1 mark]**
- Insert the picture **[1 mark]**
- Format the picture **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
A doctor measures the blood pressure of some of his patients regularly. The patients take home a blood pressure machine and record their results on a spreadsheet which the doctor has created. Part of the spreadsheet is shown.

![Spreadsheet showing blood pressure data from 10 to 16 February. Columns include date, systolic, diastolic, and warning levels ranging from normal to severe.](assets/001-spreadsheet-showing-blood-pressure-data-from-10-.png)

At the end of the month the doctor needs to produce a hard copy document showing information about a patient: their name, date of birth and patient number, as well as data and the graph from the spreadsheet.

**Design **a suitable document layout. The document must have appropriate spacing.
parts.solution_md:
![Blood pressure report with graph; includes patient details and a table of dates, systolic and diastolic readings, and warnings, ranging from normal to severe.](assets/002-blood-pressure-report-with-graph-includes-patien.png)

*Example Document Layout*

> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any **five **of the following:
> 
> - Include Name, Date of birth Include Patient Number **[1 mark]**
> - Graph is displayed  **[1 mark]**
> - Must look like a hard copy report **[1 mark]**
> - Fills the report  **[1 mark]**
> - Suitable title at the top of the page title must relate to blood pressure readings  **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
Rockit Motors has opened a car store in a shopping mall.

Customers can test drive the cars they are planning to purchase using virtual reality systems within the store.

The manager of Rockit Motors has created many different types of documents including letters and memos for the company. Each of them is produced using its corporate house style.

**Explain **why corporate house styles are required.
parts.solution_md:
A corporate house style is required to:

Any **four **of the following:

- Ensures consistency across all documents **[1 mark]**
- Lets people know that the stationery/documents belong to the same Motor company **[1 mark]**
- Easier to recognise documents from the same company **[1 mark]**
- To reduce the time spent in setting up and formatting documents **[1 mark]**
- To reduce cost of setting up and formatting documents **[1 mark]**
- To reduce the risk of errors e.g. misspellings, logos omitted, etc. **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
A school is planning to change the way it reports back to parents about their child’s academic progress. They plan to produce a mail merged document and then email this to parents.

They have created a spreadsheet which shows the pupil’s name, target, attainment and effort levels for Maths and the Science subjects.

Part of the spreadsheet is shown

![Table listing student names, target level, and attainment and effort scores in Maths, Biology, Chemistry, and Physics for Ahmad and Nurul.](assets/003-table-listing-student-names-target-level-and-att.png)

**Design **a suitable document layout to display the information of one pupil. The name of the pupil must be clearly shown separated from the rest of the data. It must have appropriate spacing. Do not include the pupil’s data.
parts.solution_md:
![Academic Progress Report table with subjects: Maths, Biology, Chemistry, Physics; columns for Target Level, Attainment, and Effort, with placeholder values.](assets/004-academic-progress-report-table-with-subjects-mat.png)

*Example Document Layout*

> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any **six **of the following:
> 
> - Name is clearly shown at the top of the data **[1 mark]**
> - Name must be on a line on its own **[1 mark]**
> - Information fills the report – Is there a large space at the bottom or side; use professional judgement **[1 mark]**
> - Suitable title at the top of the page above the name – title must relate academic progress/report **[1 mark]**
> - Must be a mail merge template or a document, a letter **[1 mark]**
> - The exact wording must be used for the following **[1 mark]**
> - Target level All four subjects: Maths, Biology, Chemistry and Physics 
> Attainment and Effort **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
A student is working on a project on the World Games. He has produced some information but has decided to produce a second layout including a table. The original layout and the new layout are shown.

*2021 World Games*

*This will be the 11th World Games, a major international multi-sport event, for sports, or disciplines within a sport, that were not contested in the Olympic Games.*

*Dates: Thu, 15 Jul 2021 – Sun, 25 Jul 2021 *
*Location: Legion Field, Birmingham, Alabama, United States *
*Host city: Birmingham, Alabama, United States *
*Opening ceremony: July 15 *
*Closing ceremony: July 25 *
*Main venue: The New Birmingham Stadium*

**The original layout**

**2021 World Games**

This will be the 11th World Games, a major international multi-sport event, for sports, or disciplines within a sport, that were not contested in the Olympic Games.

| Dates | Thu, 15 Jul 2021 – Sun, 25 Jul 2021 |
|---|---|
| Location | Legion Field, Birmingham, Alabama, United States |
| Host city | Birmingham, Alabama, United States |
| Opening ceremony | July 15 |
| Closing ceremony | July 25 |
| Main venue | The New Birmingham Stadium |

**The new layout**

**Explain**, step by step, how the table was created, without the text being entered by hand.
parts.solution_md:
The table was created, without the text being entered by hand by:

Any **four **of the following:

- Load the document **[1 mark]**
- Highlight the text **[1 mark]**
- Click Insert then Table **[1 mark]**
- Select Convert text to table **[1 mark]**
- Click on 2 columns **[1 mark]**
- Click separate by : **[1 mark]**
- Click ok **[1 mark]**

The completed table will look like this:

| Name of animal | Tiger quoll |
|---|---|

parts.solution_md:

parts.problem_md:
A company uses corporate house style within the headers and footers in its documents.

**Explain **what is meant by corporate house style.
parts.solution_md:
A corporate house style can be explained as:

Any **two** of the following:

- A set of rules **[1 mark]**
- House style states how all documents and written communication should be formatted **[1 mark]**
- Consistency across all documents in the portfolio of the company **[1 mark]**
- Used to promote the company **[1 mark]**
- Controls how the colours/font style/font size/font type/position of logo/justification of text/position and style of address details to be used **[1 mark]**

Headers and footers are needed to:

Any **two **of the following:

- To display descriptive information on each page **[1 mark]**
- Helps the user to navigate through the document **[1 mark]**
- Used for repeatable items **[1 mark]**
- Headers and footers can be on every page **[1 mark]**
- Maintains consistency in the document **[1 mark]**
- Saves time rather than writing the same things on each page **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
Many word processing packages have a number of formatting features.

The paragraph below shows some of the formatting features that can be used.

![Text announcing Northshire Steam Railway's Summer Steam Festival 2022, adding five new engines and featuring the Teal Steam Crane in Norton.](assets/005-text-announcing-northshire-steam-railway-s-summe.png)

**Write **down four of the formatting features that have been used in the paragraph shown.
parts.solution_md:
Examples of the formatting features used in the paragraph include:

Any **four **of the following:

- Bold **[1 mark]**
- Full justification **[1 mark]**
- Highlight **[1 mark]**
- Underlined **[1 mark]**
- Italic **[1 mark]**
